premises.evidence_span: a third of patients in the United States receive incomplete screenings. And if there's an abnormality in one of these regions that doesn't get captured, then the patient is almost always misdiagnosed

premises.text: AI processes prenatal exams to ensure required anatomical views are captured and prompts re-scan of missing planes
premises.evidence_span: providing feedback to Dr. Sham if he missed any key regions

premises.evidence_span: Here's an example of a pregnant patient with a fetal malformation in the fetal spine. Our AI was able to localize this fetal malformation

premises.text: Vendor-agnostic cloud deployment integrates with hospital ultrasound fleets over standard APIs
premises.evidence_span: integrate with any ultrasound machine over a standard API

premises.text: Hospitals purchase hybrid subscription and volume API pricing for ROI from time savings, fewer callbacks, malpractice mitigation, and future NTAP reimbursements
